d.a: Distribution. With the exception of a single lower elevation specimen from Hāʻupu from 2009, S. flavopicta has only been recorded at higher elevations on Kauaʻi (> 900 m), especially in and around Kōkeʻe State Park and Nā Pali-Kona Forest Reserve.
